about_the_game:
The ultimate political simulation experience.

Political Simulator is a turn-based strategy game in which you lead a political party within a democratic system. From the most radical fringes to the ideological center, you will have to navigate complex parliamentary dynamics, influence other political forces, pass key laws, and gain the support of a diverse and changing society.

🧩 Key Features

Deep Political Simulation: Control a party with its own ideology, from the far left to the far right.

Dynamic Parliamentary System: Compete with other political forces to pass laws, negotiate support, and block proposals.

Manage key areas: Education, healthcare, social services, security, and taxes. Your policies directly affect the country's budget, popularity, and stability.

25 Distinct Social Groups: Each with its own hidden electoral weight, political preferences, and sensitivity to your decisions.

Structured Turns in Legislatures: Manage your party through 16-turn legislative cycles, with an electoral phase in the last four.

Three Starting Scenarios: Choose between stable situations or critical contexts of polarization and social tension.

National Stability System: Your decisions can lead the country to equilibrium... or collapse.

💪 Will you be a moderate reformer, a revolutionary, or a power pragmatist?

Adapt your strategy according to the political and social context: form coalitions, manipulate public discourse, negotiate with ideological rivals... or impose your agenda, if you have enough strength.
